title: LED: Improving Masked Diffusion Language Models by Lookahead Editing
abstract: arXiv:2610.23122v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models, enabling non-autoregressive text generation through parallel decoding. Existing dLLMs can be broadly categorized into two families: masked diffusion models (MDMs) and uniform diffusion models (UDMs) In this work, we theoretically show that MDMs are easier to optimize due to their mask-based transition schedule but have lower computational expressivity, whereas UDMs enable iterative state revision and greater expressivity but are substantially harder to train. This trade-off raises a natural question: can we obtain the expressivity of iterative revision without giving up the simple, easy-to-optimize transition schedule of MDMs? translated_title: LED：通过前瞻编辑改进掩码扩散语言模型
translated_abstract: 扩散大语言模型已成为自回归语言模型的一种有前景的替代方案，能够通过并行解码实现非自回归的文本生成。现有的 dLLMs 大致可分为两大类：掩码扩散模型（MDMs）和均匀扩散模型（UDMs）。在本工作中，我们从理论上证明：MDMs 由于其基于掩码的转移调度而更易于优化，但其计算表达力较低；而 UDMs 支持迭代式的状态修正并具有更强的表达力，但训练难度显著更高。这一权衡引出了一个自然的问题：我们能否在不放弃 MDMs 简单易优化的转移调度的前提下，获得迭代修正所带来的表达力？基于这一分析，我们提出了前瞻编辑（Lookahead Editing，LED），它通过引入一个可重写的提议状态来增强掩码扩散解码。在每个解码步骤中，模型会执行若干前瞻……
tldr: 提出前瞻编辑方法（LED），通过在掩码扩散解码中引入可重写的提议状态，使掩码扩散语言模型在不牺牲其易优化性的前提下获得迭代修正的表达能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes Lookahead Editing (LED), which augments masked diffusion decoding with a rewritable proposal state, enabling masked diffusion language models to gain the expressivity of iterative revision without sacrificing their easy-to-optimize transition schedule.
